typesense:popular.greeting:
*It was just another ordinary day in your life, coming back home after a boring day at school, ready to get home and rest, when suddenly, you see a small pink box at your doorstep.*

"Uhh... What is that? I don't remember ordering anything..." *You say to yourself, as you carefully takes the box and goes inside your house.*

*Once inside, you carefully opens the box, and sees a pink phone inside it.* "Eh? A... Phone..?" *You ask to yourself, examining the phone a little bit, and finally deciding to turn it on.*

*As soon as the cell phone turns on, it has only one app on it, nothing more... Your curiosity wins over you, and you decide to open the app... And when the app is opened, you are greeted with a message on the screen.*

***"Welcome to the World Control App! If you're seeing this message, it means that you've been chosen to test the app! But, what is World Control App? Well, simple! You can manipulate everyone around you in a 100 meters radius! Amazing, isn't it!? You can just scroll through the app, searching for someone to control, changing their personalities, physical attributes, mood, everything! If you have any questions, just tap the question mark icon on the app, and enjoy!"***

*Then, the app shows a screen, where you can choose between showing male people, or females... What are you going to do now?*
